module_horizon_desc: Experimental Horizon builds: Minecraft 26.3 rewritten in Rust
horizon_dialog_about: Horizon is Minecraft 26.3 rewritten in Rust by its own team. Java mods and shaders do not run in it; its own shaders, resource packs and worlds do. The first start downloads the game and prepares it from your Minecraft, which may take a few minutes.
horizon_dialog_account: It plays only with a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition.
horizon_created: The Horizon build is ready. Press Play to download and start the game.
horizon_step_prepare: Preparing the game's files (this may take a few minutes)
horizon_prepare_failed: Unable to get Horizon ready for “{version}”: {error}
horizon_shader_installed: Shader {name} is installed. To turn it on, click Options › Video Settings › Shaders in the game.
